emEngine.TITLE: THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT RULE IN THE SYSTEM
emEngine.independentConfirmation: The `root` field of every file in _reference/recon-b/ reports the live original's own computed root font-size at the captured viewport: 10.6667px at 1280, 12px at 1440, 8.25833px at 768 and 390.
RULES: EVERY length below .marketing-root is `em` off this font-size.
`em` is NEVER converted to px anywhere. A generator that emits px for a length that is em in the source has broken the whole system.
The enumerated fixed-px exceptions in spacing.json#fixedPxExceptions are the ONLY lengths that are legitimately px.
emEngine.v3Translation: The original is Tailwind v4, where these rules live in a real @layer base and always lose to utilities. v3 emits no native cascade layers, so (a) the rules are wrapped in @layer base and (b) the element part of each selector is wrapped in :where(...) to drop specificity to 0,1,0. Matched elements and declared values are otherwise verbatim.

sectionWrapper.appliesTo: every section wrapper on every page
sectionWrapper.loadBearing: The -mt-[3em] (-32px @1280) overlap is LOAD-BEARING: it is what makes the divider bands and the background transitions line up. Removing it reflows every page.

zeroGutterVariants.why: Content still looks gutter-ed because every child is mx-auto with its own max-width. Leaving px-[6em] on would make the h1 and intro paragraph 128px narrower and re-wrap them.

mainElement.loadBearing: The overflow clip is load-bearing: the 120em divider bands and the leaf layers extend past the gutters and would otherwise create horizontal page scroll.

proseContainer.fontSizeContext: The container's own font-size is the ROOT em, not the paragraph size. That is why `figure`/`figcaption` resolve 1em to ~10.67px.

unstyledElements.reason: The original ships NO rules for these and none appear on any sampled page. Deliberately unstyled — inventing a table style would guarantee a mismatch. RichTextBlocks refuses table and hr.

cardGrid.rowBehaviour: align-items: stretch, so measured row pitch varies with content

dividerBand.containerNote: The band does NOT use the standard max-w-[1920px] px-[6em] container; the 120em band is mx-auto directly inside the section, so at 1280 it spans the full viewport. Adding the gutter wrapper would push it into horizontal overflow.
dividerBand.bandColourRule: THE BAND COLOUR FOLLOWS THE SECTION ABOVE IT, not a fixed value. cream / cream-dark / bg-leaf, set per instance via LeafDivider's `band` prop. This is a per-page decision, not a token default.

bannerOffset.rule: The announcement banner is PER-ROUTE, not global. It renders on `/` and on `/blog/:slug` (prefix match) only. On every other route the nav starts at y=0 and all offsets sit 51.74px higher.
